issue_context.title: Clicking on a rectangle, then text inside selects both
issue_context.body:
Repro:
- Create a rectangle with background
- Create a text in the middle
- Click on the rectangle
- Click on the text (WITHOUT shift)
- Both are selected. Only the text should be selected
